mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ext_interaction (id, ts, direction, kind, counterparty, endpoint, operation, auth_mode, credential_id, actor_id, run_as, trace_id, request_id, subject, turn_id, run_id, change_set_id, tool_call_id, idempotency_key, external_ref, dedupe_key, request_digest, response_digest, request_size, response_size, payload_ref, data_label, status, http_status, error_code, attempt, latency_ms, retention_class, attrs_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{ts}, #{direction}, #{kind}, #{counterparty}, #{endpoint}, #{operation}, #{authMode}, #{credentialId}, #{actorId}, #{runAs}, #{traceId}, #{requestId}, #{subject}, #{turnId}, #{runId}, #{changeSetId}, #{toolCallId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{externalRef}, #{dedupeKey}, #{requestDigest}, #{responseDigest}, #{requestSize}, #{responseSize}, #{payloadRef}, #{dataLabel}, #{status}, #{httpStatus}, #{errorCode}, #{attempt}, #{latencyMs}, #{retentionClass}, #{attrsJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ts, direction, kind, counterparty, endpoint, operation, auth_mode AS "authMode", actor_id AS "actorId", trace_id AS "traceId", request_id AS "requestId", subject, turn_id AS "turnId", run_id AS "runId", change_set_id AS "changeSetId", tool_call_id AS "toolCallId", idempotency_key AS "idempotencyKey", external_ref AS "externalRef", dedupe_key AS "dedupeKey", request_digest AS "requestDigest", response_digest AS "responseDigest", request_size AS "requestSize", response_size AS "responseSize", data_label AS "dataLabel", status, http_status AS "httpStatus", error_code AS "errorCode", attempt, latency_ms AS "latencyMs", retention_class AS "retentionClass", attrs_json AS "attrs" FROM ext_interaction WHERE (#{requestId}::varchar IS NULL OR request_id = #{requestId}) AND (#{subject}::varchar IS NULL OR subject = #{subject}) AND (#{counterparty}::varchar IS NULL OR counterparty = #{counterparty}) AND (#{externalRef}::varchar IS NULL OR external_ref = #{externalRef}) AND (#{kind}::varchar IS NULL OR kind = #{kind}) AND (#{direction}::varchar IS NULL OR direction = #{direction}) AND (#{from}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts >= #{from}) AND (#{to}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts <= #{to}) ORDER BY ts DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT kind, counterparty, data_label AS "dataLabel", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'OK') AS "errorCount", MAX(ts) AS "lastTs" FROM ext_interaction WHERE direction = 'OUT' AND (#{kind}::varchar IS NULL OR kind = #{kind}) AND (#{dataLabel}::varchar IS NULL OR data_label = #{dataLabel}) AND (#{from}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts >= #{from}) AND (#{to}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts <= #{to}) GROUP BY kind, counterparty, data_label ORDER BY "cnt" DESC, kind, counterparty

SELECT kind, counterparty, COUNT(*) AS "cnt", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'OK') AS "errorCount", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS "p95" FROM ext_interaction WHERE (#{kind}::varchar IS NULL OR kind = #{kind}) AND (#{from}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts >= #{from}) AND (#{to}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ts <= #{to}) GROUP BY kind, counterparty ORDER BY "cnt" DESC, kind, counterparty
